data: This course will engage significantly with a specific form of creative fiction writing: speculative fiction. It will be one of a rotating series of Genre courses that we hope to offer as part of the Creative Writing minor. Speculative fiction is an extremely popular genre among writers and students. At the outset of this course, we will engage with a fundamental question: What makes a piece of writing speculative? As the term progresses, we will look deeply at the most popular forms of speculative fiction: dystopic literature, fantasy writing and alternate history fiction. Students will work on short pieces during the first weeks, and then are expected to develop and complete a longer story by the end of term.
